scenarios.label: Personal CSI
scenarios.title: Build self-directed learning without confusing practice gains with transfer
scenarios.situation: A learner or knowledge worker wants stronger self-regulation, cognitive performance and resilience while retaining independent capability.
scenarios.recommendation: Use a layered intervention rather than a single generic brain-training prescription: explicit plan-monitor-reflect routines, targeted cognitive practice where a bottleneck is identified, and a separate stress/attention-regulation component. Treat transfer as something to measure independently rather than infer from trained-task improvement.
actions: Use explicit goal setting, monitoring, retrieval checks and post-task calibration as the core self-regulated-learning loop.
Add targeted executive or memory practice only when a specific capacity bottleneck is identified; test outcomes on separate tasks or real activities.
Use mindfulness or self-compassion practices as a regulation adjunct for stress and attentional stability, not as a substitute for task-specific learning.
Include a delayed or no-support re-check to distinguish supported performance from retained capability.
scenarios.caveat: This is a product-development demo recommendation. Several supporting sources are provisional screening records and have not yet completed full human appraisal.

scenarios.label: Work CSI
scenarios.title: Adopt GenAI without quietly offloading the judgement you still need
scenarios.situation: A high-demand professional team wants AI productivity gains without losing independent reasoning, calibration or decision quality.
scenarios.recommendation: Use a scaffolded human-AI workflow: keep purpose, problem framing, evidence judgement and final decisions human-owned; use AI selectively for alternatives, retrieval and structured support; and preserve independent no-AI checkpoints. Monitor workload and recovery because apparent speed-up can coexist with hidden cognitive or supervisory cost.
actions: Require a human-first problem representation or decision criterion before AI assistance begins for consequential tasks.
Use AI for bounded support such as alternatives, source organisation, feedback or drafting rather than default delegation of core judgement.
Add independent no-AI checks, delayed retrieval or explanation-from-memory when retained human capability matters.
Track effort, error checking, rework and supervisory load rather than assuming faster task completion means lower workload.
For persistently high-load roles, pair workflow redesign with a brief evidence-informed recovery or autonomic-regulation intervention.
scenarios.caveat: The AI/offloading sources include human-approved seed evidence; workplace intervention sources in this demo may still be provisional. Organisational deployment should be treated as a bounded experiment with outcome monitoring.

scenarios.label: Health CSI
scenarios.title: Design cognitive support around functional goals, strategy use and maintenance
scenarios.situation: A service is considering cognitive or executive-function support after neurological illness or acquired cognitive difficulty.
scenarios.recommendation: Prioritise goal-management and strategy-based rehabilitation linked to functional participation, with computerised or telehealth delivery used as a delivery mechanism rather than the intervention claim itself. Measure maintenance and real-world function separately from trained cognitive-task gains.
actions: Anchor training to personally or clinically meaningful functional goals rather than cognitive scores alone.
Use goal-management, metacognitive or compensatory strategy practice to support cueing, planning and task completion.
Choose remote, computerised or face-to-face delivery according to access, support needs and fidelity rather than assuming one medium is intrinsically superior.
Track participation, everyday functioning and delayed maintenance alongside proximal cognitive outcomes.
Keep clinical selection and treatment decisions under qualified human oversight; the Gateway supports evidence exploration, not medical prescribing.
scenarios.caveat: Health CSI demo outputs are not medical advice. The cited records shown here are provisional unless the Gateway explicitly labels them Approved.
